en.headline: School bus hits a kerb in Tai Po, children taken to hospital
en.dek: A driver reported the crash on On Po Road at 8.27am. Ambulance crews classed two children as semi-urgent and seven as minor.
body: A school bus struck a stone kerb in Tai Po on Wednesday morning, and children on board were taken to hospital conscious.

Police received a report at 8.27am from the driver, who said the bus had crashed near 12 On Po Road and that eight children were injured. Reports later said the front right of the green school bus hit a stone kerb in front of a gate. The bus was parked at the roadside while officers examined the scene.

Ambulance crews attended in numbers. Initial triage put two children in the semi-urgent yellow category and seven in the minor green category. The children were all conscious when taken to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital in Tai Po. Most walked onto the ambulances; one was taken on a stretcher after feeling unwell. No adult injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路校巴撞石壆 學童清醒送院
zh.dek: 司機上午8時27分報案，指安埔路12號對開失事。救護分流兩名學童屬黃色、七名屬綠色，全部清醒送往大埔那打素醫院。
body: 周三早上，大埔一輛校巴撞上石壆，車上學童清醒送院。
警方上午8時27分接獲校巴司機報案，指車輛在安埔路12號對開失事，車上有八名學童受傷。據報，綠色校巴駛至一處車閘前時，車頭右側撞上閘前石壆。涉事校巴其後停在路旁，由警員調查。
大批救護車到場。初步分流兩名學童屬次緊急的黃色、七名屬輕傷的綠色。受傷學童全部清醒，送往大埔那打素醫院。大部分自行走上救護車，一人感到不適，由擔架床送上救護車。暫未有成人受傷的消息。
